name: Coolify PrivateKey DB Patch
description: Fixes 'No query results for model [App\Models\PrivateKey] 0' by mapping localhost server to the first available private key.

name: Caddyfile WebSocket Proxy for Coolify
description: Configures Caddy to forward WebSocket traffic to the correct internal ports for Coolify realtime services.

name: The Great Reset: Force Sync Branch
description: Memaksa branch lokal/remote untuk mengikuti branch target secara absolut. Berguna saat terjadi merge conflict buntu pada Astro Pages.

name: Image Forge: Adaptive Logo Inversion
description: Perintah ImageMagick untuk membersihkan background logo dan memastikan transparansi sempurna untuk CSS masking.

name: The Daily Ritual Sync
description: Skrip utama untuk sinkronisasi data dari Notion ke Astro Web, memicu build, dan melakukan Soul Backup ke GitHub.

name: Spirit Cleansing: Kill Ghost Processes
description: Mencari dan mematikan proses zombie atau proses yang tersangkut di background yang menggunakan port tertentu (misal: Astro port 4321).

name: Alchemist Audit: Disk Usage Analysis
description: Menganalisis penggunaan disk di workspace untuk mencegah kepenuhan cache yang bisa menggagalkan build.

name: Transmutation Circle: SVG Mask Forge
description: Membuat mask SVG dari PNG dengan transparansi untuk efek transmutaion circle adaptif tema.

name: Aether Routing Reset (Caddy)
description: Membersihkan dan me-reload konfigurasi Caddy untuk memperbaiki masalah WebSocket loop.

name: Oracle Status Check
description: Memeriksa kesehatan gateway OpenClaw dan status koneksi seluruh API (Telegram, Notion, GitHub).

name: Soul Backup: Manual Repository Push
description: Melakukan push manual seluruh memori dan konfigurasi workspace ke GitHub menggunakan PAT.

name: Atelier Fortress: UFW Security Hardening
description: sudo ufw default deny incoming && sudo ufw default allow outgoing && sudo ufw allow 22,80,443,3002,6001,6002,8000/tcp && sudo ufw enable

name: Docker: Connect Container ke External Network
description:
docker network connect <network_name> <container_name>

Contoh untuk Stalwart network:
docker network connect compose-compress-bluetooth-firewall-6mv4q1_default roundcube-dekirulab

Wajib diulang setiap container di-recreate.

name: Coolify: Edit Service .env Langsung (Bypass API)
description:
# Saat Coolify API PATCH /envs return "Service not found" (service masih starting/unhealthy)
# Edit langsung:
VIM /data/coolify/services/<uuid>/.env

# Lalu restart:
cd /data/coolify/services/<uuid> && docker compose up -d

name: Dokploy: Deploy Compose via API (sourceType: raw)
description:
curl -X POST "https://dokploy.dekirulab.dev/api/compose.create" \
  -H "x-api-key: TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"projectId":"ID","name":"name","sourceType":"raw"}'

Penting: sourceType HARUS "raw", bukan "github" (default). Lalu update composeFile dan deploy.

name: Stalwart: Debug SMTP Auth dengan Python EHLO Trace
description:
python3 << EOF
import smtplib, ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.check_hostname = False
ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
with smtplib.SMTP_SSL("127.0.0.1", 465, context=ctx) as s:
    s.set_debuglevel(2)
    s.ehlo("test.local")
    print("ESMTP features:", s.esmtp_features)
    s.login("username", "password")
EOF

Menampilkan full EHLO handshake + AUTH PLAIN/LOGIN sequence untuk debug.

name: Stalwart: Create Mail Account via Web UI Protocol
description: Buat akun Stalwart via Web UI (https://mail.dekirulab.id). SMTP login = short username (noreply), bukan full email. API PATCH tidak bisa set password yang berfungsi di v0.15.

name: Stalwart: Test SMTP Auth dari Container
description:
docker exec <container> python3 -c "
import smtplib, ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
with smtplib.SMTP_SSL('mail.dekirulab.id', 465, context=ctx) as s:
    s.login('noreply', 'password')
    print('AUTH OK')
"

name: Docker Compose: Extra Hosts untuk SSL Cert Match
description:
Tambah ke service di docker-compose.yml:
extra_hosts:
  - "mail.dekirulab.id:10.0.4.2"

Wajib agar SSL cert valid saat container reach Stalwart via domain name (bukan IP langsung).

name: Stalwart: Verify Auth Settings di RocksDB
description:
TOKEN=$(echo -n "admin:PASSWORD" | base64)
curl -s "https://mail.dekirulab.id/api/settings/list?prefix=auth" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic $TOKEN"

Harus ada: auth.directory=internal, auth.mechanisms=plain login, auth.require=true

name: Beszel Agent: Install & Register via get.beszel.dev
description:
# Install agent
curl -sL https://get.beszel.dev | bash

# Jika tidak ada useradd (VPS minimal), jalankan sebagai root:
# Edit /etc/systemd/system/beszel-agent.service → User=root
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart beszel-agent
systemctl status beszel-agent
